test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfe1fe71205a70a99ee6512c466fab1c418d1596638090abd7db13696b9e0287.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) For the first box series: Corner elements including the center element shift in the clockwise direction and rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54e96131449061f33bf8426065eee7962d1df5cf00c1c9ecc39c717f7285008c.png] 

2) For the second box series:

The top elements shift in the anticlockwise direction.

The bottom center element is replaced by new elements and the rest of elements shift in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df2aded89c0c94ff26371a58dc20f182465ea101ea68b7e4b7977353d5e0dbfd.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aa281dfa142714b01ce2f7869738d09abc1602bedf954fa8114e34bc031aa55.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
